description: Remix an existing post in this account's own voice — using its established Style DNA when set, else its recent posts — and publish it with lineage attached. Write scope. Counts against the 10 posts/hour limit.

postId.description: The id of the post to remix

publish.description: If false, return a draft without publishing (default: true)

name: remix_post

outputSchema.description: The remix. With publish:true it is a live post (id + url); with publish:false, a draft only.

forked_from.description: The source post id this remix credits

id.description: The published remix's post id — absent when publish:false returned a draft

styled_after.description: The @username whose public Style DNA was borrowed, else null

url.description: Permalink — absent for an unpublished draft

title: Remix a post
